AboutDocument.description: The signal comments on the plan or the instruction, at one version (optionally quoting it).
AboutDocument.title: AboutDocument

AboutDrift.description: The signal is part of the discussion of a drift.
AboutDrift.title: AboutDrift

Account.description:
A person: email + password (the hash never leaves the server). Inserted by the server admin. The person
edits their own name, alias (a nickname, not unique) and avatar: the same in every org.
Account.title: Account

AccountProjects.description: Every project you are a member of, across your orgs.
AccountProjects.title: AccountProjects

Action.description:
One action of a milestone, run under a topic. Done once an agent's result says so (done_* are filled
by the server and cleared by a revoke).
Action.title: Action

ActionOutcome.description: What an agent reports about an action.
ActionOutcome.title: ActionOutcome

ActionResultBody.description: What an agent reports about a deliverables action; DONE completes it.
ActionResultBody.title: ActionResultBody

ActionRevokeBody.description: Withdraws an action's done: the action reads as in progress again.
ActionRevokeBody.title: ActionRevokeBody

ActionSpec.description: An action as submitted. A new one has no id; an existing one keeps its id (and its results and done).
ActionSpec.title: ActionSpec

ActionStatus.description: Inferred from an action's results; never stored.
ActionStatus.title: ActionStatus

AddMembers.description: Invite members of the project's org: each can then fetch their project key.
AddMembers.title: AddMembers

AdminExport.description: admin.export: one page of one table by rowid. org=None: a table of the directory (password hashes included).
AdminExport.title: AdminExport

AdminOrgImport.description: admin.org_import: into the org's own storage (the org must be in the directory: import that first).
AdminOrgImport.title: AdminOrgImport

ArtifactArchive.description: artifact.archive: the initiator hides an artifact (archived) or brings it back.
ArtifactArchive.title: ArtifactArchive

ArtifactBody.description:
One version of an artifact: stored (`stored`, exact) or linked (`url`, unpinned).

A body with neither is a draft, taken only by artifact.write, which stores the content and
fills `stored`; every accepted ARTIFACT signal has one or the other.
ArtifactBody.title: ArtifactBody

ArtifactGet.description: One version by its sg_ id, or an artifact by its chain id (its version now in force, else its newest).
ArtifactGet.title: ArtifactGet

ArtifactResult.description: artifact.write's answer: the signal's result and where the content went.
ArtifactResult.title: ArtifactResult

ArtifactWrite.description:
artifact.write: the server stores the content (any type, at most 5 MB) in its file store and
accepts the ARTIFACT signal (its body a draft, with neither stored nor url). Larger: publish a link.
ArtifactWrite.title: ArtifactWrite

AttemptState.description: One try of a task on the LLM server.
AttemptState.title: AttemptState

AvatarSet.description: account.set_avatar: a small square image (the web app crops and shrinks it first).
AvatarSet.title: AvatarSet

CommentBody.description: A comment typed by a person in the web app: free text; its first line is the signal's title.
CommentBody.title: CommentBody

Deliverables.description: A project's deliverables at one version; each publish is a new version.
Deliverables.title: Deliverables

DeliverablesArchive.description: deliverables.archive: the initiator freezes the Deliverables (archived) or restores them as they were.
DeliverablesArchive.title: DeliverablesArchive

DeliverablesDelete.description: deliverables.delete: the initiator removes the Deliverables and their history (results stay as signals).
DeliverablesDelete.title: DeliverablesDelete

DeliverablesHistory.description: deliverables.history: every version still kept, newest first (the current one included).
DeliverablesHistory.title: DeliverablesHistory

DeliverablesPublish.description: deliverables.publish: the whole structure, as a new version.
DeliverablesPublish.title: DeliverablesPublish

DeliverablesRename.description: deliverables.rename: new names for milestones and actions, by id.
DeliverablesRename.title: DeliverablesRename

DeliverablesUpdateMilestone.description:
deliverables.update_milestone: one milestone with all its actions; the rest is kept as it is. Moving an
action between milestones needs a whole publish.
DeliverablesUpdateMilestone.title: DeliverablesUpdateMilestone

DeliverablesVersion.description: One version in the Deliverables' history: who published it and when (deliverables.history).
DeliverablesVersion.title: DeliverablesVersion

DeliverablesVersions.description: Newest first; none when there are no Deliverables, or they are archived and you are not the initiator.
DeliverablesVersions.title: DeliverablesVersions

DeliverablesView.description: The current version with each action's status (inferred from its results) and what is late.
DeliverablesView.title: DeliverablesView

Drift.description: A conflict the runner found. Deleted only by a topic cascade.
Drift.title: Drift

DriftResolve.description: drift.resolve: the initiator marks a drift settled by its discussion.
DriftResolve.title: DriftResolve

Event.description: One row of the append-only event log; seq counts per project.
Event.title: Event

EventType.description: Sync event types (doc: Server API, Sync events).
EventType.title: EventType

ImportPage.description:
One step of restoring an export (`teamflow-server import`) into a FRESH target, refused anywhere else:
"start" (the target must be empty and not being restored; `resume`: go on with a restore that did not finish),
"rows" (a page of one table's exported rows, tables in the export's order; a row already there is skipped), then
"finish". While a restore is open an org is not set up: it answers nothing.
ImportPage.title: ImportPage

LiveClosed.description: Server to client, the last message: why the socket is closing.
LiveClosed.title: LiveClosed

LiveEvents.description:
Server to client: events of the socket's project in seq order; `cursor` is the last one's seq (or the
client's own cursor, in an empty catch-up). `reset`: only in the first answer, when the hello's cursor was beyond
the project's head (rule 2): no events, `cursor` is the head, and the client starts over from 0.
LiveEvents.title: LiveEvents

LiveHello.description: Client to server, the first message: the ticket, and the last seq the client has of the project.
LiveHello.title: LiveHello

LiveTicket.description:
A short-lived ticket for one project's live socket (tf_models.live): sent as the socket's first message, so
no key ever goes in a URL. Signed by the server for (org, project, member, expires_at).
LiveTicket.title: LiveTicket

Member.description: A person in one org. Signals, projects and approvals name members, never accounts.
Member.title: Member

NoticeType.description: Built on the client from synced events; the server stores no notices.
NoticeType.title: NoticeType

Org.description:
An org: its name, its one admin, and the projects and members it holds. Its artifacts live in the
platform's file store, under the org's id.
Org.title: Org

OrgSetTitle.description: org.set_title: the org's admin sets a member's title in the org.
OrgSetTitle.title: OrgSetTitle

Person.description:
How a project member is shown: their name and alias (one per person), their avatar's hash, and their titles
(the org's, set by its admin; this project's, set by its initiator).
Person.title: Person

ProfileUpdate.description: account.update_profile: the person's own name and alias (the same in every org).
ProfileUpdate.title: ProfileUpdate

Project.description: One row per project, updated in place; topics live in their own table.
Project.title: Project

ProjectKey.description: A project key, minted for the member who asks (one per machine or browser; all revoked together).
ProjectKey.title: ProjectKey

ProjectSetTitle.description: project.set_title: the initiator sets a member's title in the project.
ProjectSetTitle.title: ProjectSetTitle

ProjectState.description: Rolling, append-only: every change inserts a new row; the latest is current.
ProjectState.title: ProjectState

ProjectSummary.description: Counts for a project card, so a list of projects needs no project keys.
ProjectSummary.title: ProjectSummary

RemoveMember.description: The initiator removes a member (not themselves): their project keys are revoked.
RemoveMember.title: RemoveMember

RpcError.title: RpcError
RpcError.description: A JSON-RPC error. `data.reason` is a RejectReason when the server gives one.

RunnerComplete.description: runner.complete: the attempt's output, or why it failed.
RunnerComplete.title: RunnerComplete

RunnerStarted.description: runner.started: the attempt began on the LLM server.
RunnerStarted.title: RunnerStarted

Signal.description: As sent by the client; never changed once stored.
Signal.title: Signal

SignalResult.description: signal.emit always answers with one of these; a rejection is never a JSON-RPC error.
SignalResult.title: SignalResult

StoredRef.description: Exactly where one stored version is: its key in the file store, <org>/<project>/<artifact>/<version>.
StoredRef.title: StoredRef

StoredSignal.description: A signal plus what the server added.
StoredSignal.title: StoredSignal

SyncBatch.description:
`reset` lists each project whose cursor was beyond its head (the sync.poll rule, tf_models.live): no events
for it, its cursor is the head, and the client drops what it holds of the project and pulls it again from 0.
SyncBatch.title: SyncBatch

Task.description: An asynchronous job the context server hands to the LLM server.
Task.title: Task

TaskAttempt.description: One try of a task; a retry is a new row.
TaskAttempt.title: TaskAttempt

TaskKind.description:
Asynchronous jobs the context server hands to the LLM server. More kinds come later
(e.g. create-action-list, draw-work-graph).
TaskKind.title: TaskKind

TopicSpec.description: A topic as given when it is created.
TopicSpec.title: TopicSpec

UpdateSignal.description: Which signals led to a state row; written once, with that row.
UpdateSignal.title: UpdateSignal

WriteState.description: project.write_state: the initiator writes a new plan and instruction version by hand.
WriteState.title: WriteState
